text: Frame correspondence: the modal axiom 5 (◇φ → □◇φ) is valid exactly on frames whose accessibility relation is ___ (the first-order condition wRv ∧ wRu ⇒ vRu).
explanation: Axiom 5 corresponds to the Euclidean property: if wRv and wRu then vRu. Combined with reflexivity (T) and transitivity (4), this yields an equivalence relation, characterizing S5.
